title: Kevin Estre completes TOYOTA RACING's 2027 driver line-up
summary: TOYOTA RACING has finalised its race driver line-up for the 2027 FIA World Endurance Championship (WEC) season with the addition of Kevin Estre.
body_markdown:
Nov. 20, 2026


# Kévin Estre completes TOYOTA RACING's 2027 driver line-up


News ReleaseMotorsportWEC


Download all images


TOYOTA RACING


TOYOTA RACING has finalised its race driver line-up for the 2027 FIA World Endurance Championship (WEC) season with the addition of Kévin Estre.


Kévin, who raced in the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship in the United States in 2026, has victories in 24-hour races at Le Mans, Nürburgring and Spa-Francorchamps to his name, as well as two WEC titles (2018-19 in LM GTE Pro and 2024 in Hypercar).


He replaces the retired Mike Conway in the #7 TR010 HYBRID alongside Kamui Kobayashi and Nyck de Vries. Newly crowned drivers' World Champions Sébastien Buemi, Brendon Hartley and Ryō Hirakawa will compete together in the #8 TR010 HYBRID for the sixth consecutive season.


Additionally, Esteban Masson, part of TOYOTA's driver development activities, will step up to become the team's test and reserve driver in 2027. The Frenchman already has Hypercar testing experience and drove the TR010 HYBRID during the Le Mans test day earlier this year.


TOYOTA RACING goes into its 15th season in WEC after a highly successful 2026, which included wins at the Le Mans 24 Hours and its home race at Fuji Speedway on the way to the manufacturers' and drivers' World Championships.


### Quotes


#### Kamui Kobayashi (Team Principal and driver, car #7)


"I'm very pleased to welcome Kévin to the team. Of course, we know him well as a fierce competitor in WEC and it's great that he will now be driving with us in the #7 TR010 HYBRID. His arrival means we continue to have a line-up of experienced and successful drivers, alongside our new test and reserve driver Esteban, who has shown great potential in LMP2 and LMGT3. We're all looking forward to working together to take on the challenges ahead."


#### Nyck de Vries (Driver, car #7)


"It's truly a pleasure to be part of this team and to be racing in the #7 car for the fourth season. I'm happy to be driving alongside Kamui again and looking forward to working with Kévin. After such a successful year, we know our competitors will come back stronger and we need to be at the top of our game again, but I'm already excited about 2027."


#### Kévin Estre (Driver, car #7)


"I can't wait to get started at TOYOTA RACING. The team has become a benchmark in WEC in terms of performance and operations over the years, and I know from experience how tough it is to race against them. So, I'm looking forward to becoming part of the team and challenging for Le Mans wins and world titles together. At the same time, I'm happy and grateful to be able to continue competing in IMSA. With full seasons in WEC and IMSA, it will be another exciting year for me."


#### Sébastien Buemi (Driver, car #8)


"I'm extremely proud and happy to continue with the team. Having first discussed the project in November 2011 and still being here for 2027 feels incredible. I would like to thank the team for their continuous support and trust over the years. On the back of such an amazing year in 2026 I can't wait to be back in the car and with the team. I'm looking forward to a strong 2027."


#### Brendon Hartley (Driver, car #8)


"I'm really happy to be sharing car #8 with Séb and Ryō again next year. We know each other really well, enjoy racing together and have built a strong relationship over the years. Of course, we all have the same ambition to fight for wins, get back on the top step at Le Mans and challenge for the championship. There's always room to improve, and I'm looking forward to another season of pushing each other and achieving more together with TOYOTA RACING."


#### Ryō Hirakawa (Driver, car #8)


"The 2026 season for us was very successful, winning Le Mans, our home race at Fuji Speedway, the manufacturers' World Championship and for us on car #8, winning the drivers' title. We couldn't do a better job than that. I am happy to race alongside Séb and Brendon again in car #8 and we all welcome Kévin to the team. I think we've got strong line-up and it's going to be a really exciting season. I am expecting a new challenge in 2027, but we are ready for it."


#### Esteban Masson (Test and reserve driver)


"It's an honour to join TOYOTA RACING as test and reserve driver. To be part of a World Championship-winning team is a big opportunity and an important step in my development as a driver. I would like to thank TOYOTA for their ongoing trust and confidence. I can't wait to get the opportunity to drive the TR010 HYBRID again."
